intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season dan semua surcharge dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Buka panel itinerary hanya bila nak ubah hari; setiap blok membawa kawasannya sendiri, jadi kadar transport dan malam tambahan berlabuh pada blok yang dipilih.

paxNotes.text: 1 pax: harga katalog bermula 2 pax — sahkan kadar dengan PO.
Maksimum 1 beg besar setiap pax — kapasiti kenderaan terhad.
ST kereta sewa: rate sheet setakat 5–6 pax — untuk 7 pax ke atas sahkan bilangan kereta dengan PO.
Melebihi 10 pax: tiada kadar transport tersiar — sahkan dengan PO.

validity: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission and are quoted in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) per pax, based on 2–3 pax sharing a room. Deposit RM1,000 per pax upon confirmation; full payment 45 days prior to departure. Rates follow the ARBA 2026 catalogue v3, valid for travel until 31 March 2027. Itinerary and prices are subject to change without prior notice and to availability at the time of booking.
